description: versus-2p-bamboo with D_800A3790 (0x800A3790) poked 0x23 -> 0x03 at the top menu (a modified game: bit 5 cleared); the only stores are 0x23, by func_80046B44 (368E4.c:429-447, boot and every reinit) and func_80046E8C (368E4.c:543, no caller); gpu_ProjectQueuedNodeRunVerticesAndDispatchPackets and func_8004A940 (0x8004B6C8) copy it to scratchpad 0x1F8001C0, where gpu_EmitOtCutoffFlatLitTexturedQuadsWithOptionalSubdivision and the node case at 0x8004B8AC / 0x8004B9E8 (in func_8004A940's extent) test bits 0-1 (andi 3: selects the right shift applied to halfwords 6-0xC of each record, with 0x1F8001E0 and a depth level) and bit 2 (andi 4); gpu_PrepareViewAndFlushDrawQueue tests bit 3 (versus-2p-fog-cutoff-poke); no read of bit 5 found
